about: Decisions for the Splash art page (the first sub-page of Official arts). splash.py reads this file. Every different picture that catalog.groups() puts in the splash room (every picture of a splash-art folder of _all) must be in keep or moved, or the script stops. keep has two groups: official (the default) and site (made for this site).
rules: Splash art holds every picture of the splash-art folders of _all that can be shown as a 16:9 window, in two groups. Official splash art: the skin splash arts of the ten Aspirants and the official art of a pair, a group or a post. Made for this site: pictures of a splash-art folder that an image generator made. They come after the official ones. A generated picture is never labelled official and never shown as a character's splash art.

A picture is generated when its file carries an OpenAI content credential (the c2pa marker, the caBX chunk of a PNG), or is a pixel exact crop of such a file (4570f6 is a crop of 20d357, so only 20d357 is kept). splash.py stops if a site picture is not generated or an official one is.

Every site item has canon fan, the credit Made for this site with the note Generated for this site. Not official art., the tag made for this site, the eyebrow Made for this site, the fact kind Made for this site (artist, date and source null), and a line that says in one plain sentence that it is not official art.
A generated picture that sits in an art or poster folder (not splash-art) stays in Others only (Vexana and Guinevere in a window, Vexana profile card).
A picture goes in keep only when its 16:9 window is at least 1000 px wide in source pixels (the page window is about 730 CSS px wide on a laptop). Nothing is upscaled and the threshold is not bent.

img is always the whole picture. frame is the 16:9 window as fractions of it. A square or portrait picture is cut to the window that keeps the most (the face or figure, the hands, the weapon, any text, the horizon), and crop_why says what the window keeps and loses. focus is the point to keep in view in a narrow window (about 9:16), normally the face. The page shows the middle 80 percent of the frame at rest, so splash.py needs the focus point inside it.

Facts are only what a source says. artist is null for every picture because the studio does not credit its splash artists (searched 11 Nov 2026). platform is null for a skin splash art because no source shows where the picture was first posted. A picture that is the art of an official post (key post) takes the post's date, platform and address, and post_note says how.

date of a single skin splash art is the day its skin went on sale, from the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post. A pair art has no date unless a post carries the same art: the only date its file holds is a save date, which is not a publication date.

Not splash art, so not here: film frames (they go to Scene), trailer cards (a title is in the picture), lore cards, place pictures the Lore atlas already shows, an edited copy of a post, and pictures under 1000 px wide.

keep.title: Fanny, Blade of Kibou
keep.alt: Fanny with orange hair in a high ponytail leaps through a bright blue sky with a thin blade in each hand and a glass city behind her.
keep.line: Fanny leaps across the bright city sky with a blade in each hand.

keep.title: Layla, Miss Hikari
keep.alt: Layla with long pink twin tails kneels behind a long white cannon while a round black droid with a cyan face floats in the foreground.
keep.line: Layla kneels behind her long white cannon, her round black droid close beside her.

keep.title: Fanny and Layla, fighting together
keep.alt: Layla with pink twin tails swings a huge white cannon across the frame while Fanny with orange hair dives in beside her, in a bright city of glass towers.
keep.line: Layla and Fanny strike side by side above a bright city.

keep.title: Ruby, Mecha Maiden
keep.alt: Ruby with dark hair and pink ends swings a huge white and orange blade over a blue night city, with dark machine hands reaching in from the right.
keep.line: Ruby swings her huge white and orange blade over a blue city at night.

keep.title: Angela, Cyber Cherubin
keep.alt: Angela with peach pink twin tails and large pink and white rabbit ear headphones sits in a sunny rest area at 8:31 AM, with a small chibi companion, a floating drone and a cup of bubble tea.
keep.line: Angela sits in a sunny rest area with a tiny companion and a floating drone.

keep.title: Lesley, Deadeye Spectre
keep.alt: Lesley with long blonde hair dives through the air above a pale city, aiming an orange and gold cannon with a large red and orange wing module behind her.
keep.line: Lesley dives above a pale city with her sniper cannon and its wing module open.

keep.title: Chang'e, Tech Tensai
keep.alt: Chang'e with pink twin tails, a green streak, round glasses and rabbit ears reaches out from a white mecha in front of a glowing blue ring, with a city and distant flying shapes behind her.
keep.line: Chang'e reaches out from her rabbit eared mecha in front of a glowing ring.

keep.title: Guinevere, Daybreak Halo
keep.alt: Guinevere with long pale hair that fades to violet and a red bow leaps through the sky with gold star blades, round droids and glowing red crystals around her.
keep.line: Guinevere leaps through the clouds with her star blades, round droids and red crystals around her.

keep.title: Vexana, Twilight Star
keep.alt: Vexana with silver blue hair stands on a rooftop at night in front of a huge dark mecha that holds a giant violet sword.
keep.line: Vexana stands on a night rooftop with a huge dark mecha and its giant sword behind her.

keep.title: Guinevere and Vexana, splash art
keep.alt: Vexana's face in profile fills the left of the frame in pale violet light, while Guinevere flies toward the right and small figures fight in the distance.
keep.line: Vexana's face fills the left in pale light while Guinevere flies away to the right.

keep.title: Guinevere and Vexana, fighting moment
keep.alt: Vexana lunges with a dark spear at the left while Guinevere reaches out at the upper right, both under a dark spiked crown of violet energy.
keep.line: Vexana and Guinevere rush forward together under a dark crown of violet energy.

keep.title: Guinevere and Vexana, fighting stance
keep.alt: Vexana in white and violet stands at the left and Guinevere in red and gold floats at the right with her droids, in front of a dark violet storm.
keep.line: Vexana and Guinevere stand ready in a dark violet storm.

keep.title: Selena, Silverbolt Raiko
keep.alt: Selena with long golden hair and small horns flies forward with a grin in a blue and silver mecha suit, with small chibi faces floating in the corners.
keep.line: Selena flies forward with a grin, her blue and silver mecha at her side.

keep.title: Obsidia, Imperatrix Arashi
keep.alt: Obsidia with long blonde and pink hair in a black gown raises one gloved hand in a ring of dark red light, a silver and pink weapon at her side.
keep.line: Obsidia stands in a ring of dark light with a silver and pink weapon at her side.

keep.title: Fanny and Layla, key art
keep.alt: Fanny and Layla leap through a bright sky with a long blade between them and the Aspirants logo at the top left.
keep.line: Fanny and Layla leap through a bright sky with a long blade between them.
keep.post_note: Same art with banner text, official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

keep.title: Fanny and Layla, blue sky
keep.alt: Fanny and Layla stand together under a blue sky with white clouds and a city behind them.
keep.line: Fanny and Layla stand side by side under a bright blue sky.
keep.crop_why: Exactly 16:9, 1000 px wide (the smallest window the page accepts). No crop.

keep.title: Guinevere raises a fist
keep.alt: Guinevere raises one fist in a burst of colored rays, with two white droids and orange gloves floating around her.
keep.line: Guinevere raises a fist in a burst of colored rays, with her white droids around her.
keep.crop_why: Near square, 1080 by 1027. The window keeps the raised fist, her face, her body to the waist and both droids, and loses the legs and some ray burst.

keep.title: The Aspirants on a photo frame
keep.alt: The ten Aspirants stand and crouch in a row on a large photo frame lying on a wooden desk, with a ribbon, tape and small props around it.
keep.line: The ten Aspirants pose together on a photo frame on a wooden desk.
keep.crop_why: 1080 by 697. The window loses 45 px of desk at the top and 45 px at the bottom, and keeps all ten and the whole frame.
keep.post_note: Cropped from the art of an official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Instagram post

keep.title: Lesley with an energy cannon
keep.alt: Lesley crouches with a long orange and blue cannon in a dusky ruined city lit by sparks.
keep.line: Lesley crouches with a glowing cannon in a ruined city, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Square, 1254 px. The 16:9 window keeps her head, the whole cannon and her knee, and loses the boots and the dark ground.

keep.title: Lesley and Chang'e at sunrise
keep.alt: Lesley stands on a rooftop with a long orange cannon at sunrise as a small Chang'e floats beside her.
keep.line: Lesley and Chang'e on a rooftop at sunrise, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Square, 1254 px. The window keeps both faces, the droid and the cannon wings, and loses the sky and the lower legs.

keep.title: Vexana and Guinevere, dark vortex
keep.alt: Guinevere and Vexana stand in front of a huge purple vortex, with small cat droids floating beside Guinevere.
keep.line: Guinevere and Vexana before a purple vortex, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Portrait, 1122 by 1402. The window keeps both faces, the cat droid and the shuriken stars, and loses the lower body, which fades to plain dark.

keep.title: Vexana and Guinevere before the Singularity
keep.alt: Vexana and Guinevere face each other at the top of a tall dark diamond of purple light, with a small group of figures standing below.
keep.line: Vexana and Guinevere face to face across a dark diamond, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Portrait, 1122 by 1402. The window keeps both faces and the whole diamond. The four small figures below it do not fit with the faces, so they only show in the full view.

keep.title: Obsidia in crystal shards
keep.alt: Obsidia with pink hair glances back inside a burst of purple crystal shards.
keep.line: Obsidia in a burst of crystal shards, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Portrait, 1122 by 1402. The window keeps her face, shoulder and the glowing gem, and loses the lower body, which is only a purple haze.

keep.title: Obsidia holds a glowing card
keep.alt: Obsidia with long pink and gold hair holds a glowing card above a dark city under purple lightning.
keep.line: Obsidia holds a glowing card above a dark city, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Portrait, 1122 by 1402. The window keeps her face, the crown, the card and her hand, and loses the legs and the city below.

keep.title: Selena and Obsidia face to face
keep.alt: Selena and Obsidia face each other across a field of blue and purple light.
keep.line: Selena and Obsidia face to face in blue and purple light, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Portrait, 1122 by 1402. Both faces and the crossing blade sit in the upper half, so the window keeps them and loses the dark floor.

keep.title: Selena and Obsidia, split poster
keep.alt: A tall poster split by a diagonal, Selena on the blue half and Obsidia on the pink half.
keep.line: Selena and Obsidia on a split poster, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Portrait, 1122 by 1402. Both figures sit in the middle band, so the window keeps them across the diagonal and loses the empty blue and pink above and below.

keep.title: Selena and Obsidia poster
keep.alt: A tall poster of Selena and Obsidia at the center, with the other Aspirants flying beside them over a city.
keep.line: Selena and Obsidia with the other Aspirants over a city, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Portrait, 1122 by 1402. The window keeps Selena down to the waist, Obsidia's face, the long blade and the flying Aspirants, and loses her legs and the city below.

keep.title: Terrinia skyline
keep.alt: A dusk skyline of Terrinia with tall towers under pink clouds, in a thin frame.
keep.line: A Terrinia skyline at dusk, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Wide, 1930 by 815. The window is centred on the tallest tower and keeps its second tower and the whole height. It loses a strip of sky at each side.

keep.title: Storm Citadel in red fire
keep.alt: A huge city turned upside down in red fire above blue clouds, in a thin frame.
keep.line: Storm Citadel in red fire, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Wide, 1930 by 815. The window is centred on the fire and keeps the whole height. It loses the dark blocks at each side.

keep.title: Aerial view of Terrinia
keep.alt: An aerial view of a bay city with a tall tower sending up a thin ring of cyan light, in a thin frame.
keep.line: An aerial view of Terrinia, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Wide, 1930 by 815. The window keeps the tower with its ring of light, the whole bay and the full height. It loses the left shore.

keep.title: A tall tower above clouds
keep.alt: A tall tower with a ring around it rises above a sea of pink and purple clouds, in a thin frame.
keep.line: A tall tower above the clouds, generated for this site and not official art.
keep.crop_why: Wide, 1930 by 815. The window keeps the whole tower and its ring and the full height. It loses clouds at each side.
